title: swissALTIRegio, digital elevation model
used_for: height above sea level at the centre of each inhabited hectare (80 m cells), averaged over residents

title: Arealstatistik der Schweiz (land use statistics), hectare points
STATPOP 2025: permanent residents by commune and citizenship
used_for: diversity of citizenships (Swiss counted as one of them); the 124 citizenships with 500 or more residents nationwide each count as one group, the rest (0.10% of residents) as many small groups

title: Bildungsstand – Geodaten 2023 (educational attainment), communes
used_for: share of residents aged 25 to 64 whose highest completed education is tertiary (TERTIARY, rounded percentages, register data with an imputation model); communes with fewer than 100 residents aged 25 to 64 (75) are published as a 20-point class only (TERTIARY_C) and take its middle

title: Steuerbelastung in den Gemeinden 2018 (tax burden in the communes)
terms: ESTV: OPEN BY, source required (confirmed by e-mail, November 2026)
used_for: cantonal, communal and church taxes as % of a gross labour income of CHF 100,000: single person (Ledig), married single earner without children (VOK), with two children (VMK), married double earners with two children (DOPMK); weighted by residents (STATPOP 2018) when communes are added up

title: Leerwohnungszählung (vacant dwellings count), 1 June
used_for: vacant dwellings as a share of all dwellings (the FSO's vacancy rate; for communes without a vacant dwelling the rate is 0)

title: Strassenverkehrslärm Tag (daytime road traffic noise exposure), sonBASE
used_for: share of residents whose hectare centre lies in a 40 m cell with daytime road noise of 55 dB(A) or more (cells without a value count as quieter; 1.2% of residents)

title: Reisezeit zu 6 grossen Zentren mit dem öffentlichen Verkehr (travel time to 6 major centres by public transport)
used_for: minutes from the traffic zone of each inhabited hectare to the fastest reachable of Basel, Bern, Geneva, Lausanne, Lugano and Zurich, including access and egress, averaged over residents

title: ÖV-Güteklassen 2026 (public transport quality classes)
used_for: share of residents whose hectare centre lies in class A, B or C (very good to medium service)

title: Dienstleistungen für die Bevölkerung – Erreichbarkeit (services to the population: accessibility), hectares
used_for: road distance from home to the nearest compulsory school (D_SCHOOL_O), primary care practice (D_MEDIC_B), grocery shop (D_GROCERY) and forest edge (D_FOREST), averaged over residents

title: STATPOP 2025, permanent residents by commune and five-year age group
used_for: share of residents aged 0 to 19 (age groups 1-4 of men and women); residents in 2025 and 2015 for density and population change

title: Klimanormwerte 1991-2020, mean yearly sunshine duration 1991-2020 relative to max possible
used_for: value of the 1 km cell of each inhabited hectare, averaged over residents

title: Wohnungsinventar und Zweitwohnungsanteil 2026-10 (housing inventory and second homes rate)
used_for: share of second homes among all dwellings (ZWG_3120, weighted by ZWG_3150 when communes are added up)
